purpose: Prepare Source32 Learn native empty-draft insertion candidate and its functional contracts
authorization: Root GO after Source31 diagnostic closed; no main TypingArea, engine, scoring, timing, backend or 3D edits authorized in this subtask

implementation.sharedCommitDraft: Existing fallback CompositionEchoGuard.consume then ignoreEmptySpace then commit with exact existing provenance then setDraft empty is extracted into one callback. Both beforeinput and existing onChange fallback call it.
implementation.fastPath: Native textarea beforeinput listener is attached after useWordCorrection's effect. It cancels a supported native insertion and commits the supplied data exactly once without writing native value or selection.
eligibility: event.data contains neither CR nor LF
event.isComposing and current composition ref are both false
Actual native textarea value is empty
Current controller status is ready or running
implementation.listenerOrder: Word correction processes deletion and empty-space rejection first. Accepted Space must not be examined against the editable floor after that same Space has already been committed.
implementation.normalization: No manual data normalization or filtering. CR/LF data falls through to the native textarea because its line-break normalization occurs before the existing fallback reads .value. Controller NFC and grapheme handling remain unchanged.
implementation.clock: No timestamp overrides. The existing commit/controller path starts on its first nonempty insertion attempt. Ready empty-space rejection, pause and restart retain existing controller ownership.
implementation.echo: No skip-next-input or text-equality heuristic was added. Existing explicit composition input ownership remains authoritative; a genuine identical insertText without keydown remains independent.
implementation.fallback: Untrusted/synthetic, noncancelable, composing/IME, replacement, paste/drop, line-break, nonempty draft and unavailable-session events retain the existing path. Hardware dead-key composition is not guessed from keydown codes.

newFunctionalContracts.name: trusted letters and an accepted space commit once without a native draft or an idle clock
newFunctionalContracts.checks: Uses actual browser typing on a touch viewport. Initial invalid Space leaves cursor0 and clock0. Trusted cancelable beforeinput events are prevented; native input event count is0; all core attempts/events and accuracy remain exact. Includes accepted word separator to check listener order, first event offset0 and actual wall-clock bounds.

newFunctionalContracts.name: untrusted and noncancelable input fallbacks preserve composition ownership and a genuine repeated letter
newFunctionalContracts.checks: Synthetic beforeinput by itself cannot advance cursor, and subsequent input-only native-value simulation commits once. Composition NFC and final owned echo commit once, then an actual browser insertion of the identical letter with no keydown remains a distinct attempt. Four exact events and provenance are checked.
newFunctionalContracts.limitation: Synthetic noncancelable beforeinput is untrusted. This does not prove all trusted OS noncancelable event sequences.

newFunctionalContracts.name: pause, resume and a new lesson keep trusted insertions in their own session
newFunctionalContracts.checks: Actual typed prefix survives pause/resume with an actual measured pause interval. Finishing and starting next lesson gives a different session ID, fresh clock, two exact new attempts and no old pause intervals.

newFunctionalContracts.name: line breaks retain native textarea normalization instead of the direct insertion path
newFunctionalContracts.checks: Actual browser insertText with CRLF must use native input fallback and produce one LF-normalized canonical event with exactly three attempts.

existingContractsToRetain: Existing learning wrong-key feedback, corrections and stop-on-error immutable evidence tests
Existing current-word-correction adaptive incorrect-word reopening and correct replacement locking test
Existing mobile-input-integrity adaptive insertReplacementText and input-only provenance contracts
Existing ten-language lesson adapter, result focus and saved evidence projection tests

performanceProtocol.claim: UNVERIFIED until root-owned functional and performance runs finish
performanceProtocol.cardinalityChangeIsIntentional: Accepted Learn insertions now have a trusted canceled beforeinput and no native input event. The controller event log and insertion-attempt cardinality must still equal actual supplied text units.
performanceProtocol.requiredAdditionalAssessment: Report keyboard interaction p98 grouped by actual interactionId as well as the original event-weighted p98. Do not claim a win solely from reducing the number or weighting of input event entries.
performanceProtocol.nonnegotiable: Use unchanged native keystroke sequence, device/CPU settings, accurate result/evidence assertions and source/build fingerprints. No 3D quality reduction.
